task.title: Setting Up Streaming
task.shortdesc: Connect OBS Studio to a streaming service using RTMP.

context.p: OBS Studio streams to any service that accepts an RTMP or RTMPS ingest URL and stream key. The steps below use the generic Custom... service option, which works with any RTMP-compatible platform.

step.cmd: Set Service to Custom..., or select your platform if it's listed by name.
Enter the Server (RTMP ingest URL) provided by your streaming platform.
Paste your platform's Stream Key into the Stream Key field.

info.note: Treat your stream key like a password. Anyone with it can stream to your channel.

step.cmd: Click Apply, then Start Streaming from the Controls panel.
